title: Saves that survive
hints: For the checksum, find where the last line starts in the original text: the hash covers exactly the characters before that point.
Parse into a fresh `SaveData` and assign it to `out` only at the very end, after every check has passed.
requirements: The save file round-trips exactly, including names with spaces and an empty unlocked list.
Damaged, cut-off or edited files are detected by the checksum, and the backup is used instead.
Version 1 files are migrated; files from a newer version are reported, not misread.
The score table stays sorted, keeps the earliest of equal scores first, and holds five.
stretch: Add several save slots with a summary line each (level, coins, last played), and write the file through lesson 6.01's temporary-file-and-rename so a crash while saving can never damage it.
